stemMd: A dictionary added more entries this year than last year but became shorter in page count. Which fact best explains this?

options.label: B
options.textMd: Some newly added words are uncommon.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Some definitions were reviewed by specialists.

options.label: D
options.textMd: The new edition removed lengthy usage notes and used a more compact layout.

options.label: E
options.textMd: The cover uses a different photograph.

explanationMd: The number of entries is only one contributor to physical length. Shorter ancillary material and denser layout can more than offset additional entries, so the two reported changes are compatible.

distractorRationale.a: Sales do not determine page count.
distractorRationale.e: A cover photograph does not explain fewer interior pages.
distractorRationale.c: Review does not establish reduced length.
